build_gemma3n_e4b_model: build a Gemma3n_E4B transformer model with 35 layers and hidden dimension 16384
build_gemma3n_e2b_model: build a Gemma3n_E2B transformer model with 30 layers and hidden dimension 8192
create_gemma3n_config: create a TransformerConfig for Gemma3n with custom hidden dimension and layer count using _get_gemma3n_config
review_gemma3nbase_text_only: review the _Gemma3nBase class text_only attribute to skip the vision encoder and save memory
summarize_attention_pattern: summarize the GEMMA3N_ATTENTION_PATTERN with four local sliding and one global attention types
